requirements.summary: Implement a single-route landing page with anchored sections (nav, hero, menu, about, location & hours, testimonials, footer).
acceptanceCriteria: All sections render on a single route/page (no multi-page routing required).
Top navigation links scroll to the correct section anchors.
Menu section shows at least 6 items with consistent styling and readable pricing.
Page includes a footer with social link placeholders (non-functional OK) and a visible copyright line.

file_operations.description: Create the root App component that renders the single-page coffee landing experience (single route) and delegates to a dedicated CoffeeLandingPage component.

Create the one-page layout with semantic sections and stable anchor IDs: #home (hero), #menu, #about, #location, #testimonials, and #footer; include menu (>=6 items), testimonials (>=3), and footer with social placeholders + copyright.
Create a top navigation bar with anchor links to each section and a primary CTA link/button that scrolls to the menu section.
Create the footer with social link placeholders (e.g., Instagram/X/Facebook) and a visible copyright line; include the brand logo image placement (wired in REQ-4).

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive coffee-themed visual design system (warm earthy palette, typography scale, spacing, consistent components) across the page.
acceptanceCriteria: Typography and color palette are consistent across hero, sections, and footer.
Buttons, cards, and headings share a unified style system (hover/focus states included).
The design is clearly coffee-themed (warm, earthy aesthetic) and does not rely on blue/purple as primary brand colors.

file_operations.description: Add global styles and Tailwind layers for a coffee-themed design system: define warm/earthy CSS variables for the existing Tailwind color tokens, set typography scale, base spacing rules, smooth scroll behavior, and consistent focus/hover states.
Enhance document head for branding/typography (e.g., add font loading and meta theme color) to support the cohesive coffee aesthetic without changing routing.
Ensure all section layouts use the same spacing rhythm, heading styles, and shared UI patterns (button style, card style, section headers) so the page avoids a default/template look.

requirements.summary: Add responsive layouts and a mobile-friendly navigation that stays usable at small widths.
acceptanceCriteria: No horizontal scrolling at common breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop).
Navigation remains usable on mobile (links accessible without overlap).
Hero, menu cards, and testimonials reflow appropriately (stack on mobile, grid on larger screens).

file_operations.description: Implement responsive navigation behavior (collapsed mobile menu with a toggle) and ensure anchor links remain accessible and readable on small screens.
Apply responsive grid/stacking rules for hero layout, menu cards (stack on mobile, multi-column on larger screens), and testimonial cards; ensure padding/typography scale down cleanly.
Add responsive typography and layout safeguards (e.g., max-widths, overflow-x prevention) to prevent horizontal scrolling and maintain readability on mobile/tablet.

requirements.summary: Include custom generated static images (logo, hero image, background texture) under frontend/public/assets/generated and render them in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: All required generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the frontend (no backend image serving).
Hero section displays the hero image without distortion (proper object-fit/cropping).
Logo is used in the navigation and/or footer and remains legible at small sizes.
Background pattern/texture is subtle and does not harm text readability (sufficient contrast).

file_operations.description: Add the generated coffee brand logo mark + wordmark asset at this exact path for static frontend use.
Add the generated wide hero image asset at this exact path for static frontend use.
Add the generated seamless subtle background texture asset at this exact path for static frontend use.

Wire the generated hero image (frontend/public/assets/generated/coffee-hero.dim_1920x1080.png) into the hero section with non-distorting presentation (proper fit/crop) and ensure text overlays remain readable.
Wire the generated logo (frontend/public/assets/generated/coffee-logo.dim_512x512.png) into the navigation with a legible small-size rendering and appropriate alt text.
Optionally reuse the generated logo (frontend/public/assets/generated/coffee-logo.dim_512x512.png) in the footer to reinforce branding while maintaining contrast and legibility.
Apply the generated background texture (frontend/public/assets/generated/coffee-texture.dim_1024x1024.png) as a subtle page background treatment with sufficient contrast so content remains readable.
